# GET /api/v1/teams/{id}/repos

List all repositories belonging to a team

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-064`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| id | path | integer (int64) | True |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — []*api.Repository

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | repo ID |
| `name` | string | repo name |
| `full_name` | string | owner/name |
| `permissions` | Permission | user permissions on repo |

- **404** — team does not exist or user not a team member
- **500** — DB error fetching repos or permissions

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Team membership or org ownership required to access team endpoints | authorization | User is not site admin AND not org owner AND not team member |
| N+1 permission check pattern in GetTeamRepos - each repo requires individual permission lookup | business_logic | For each repo in the team |
